exposure: cerebral vascular malformations (EVM) in women with epilepsy
focal epilepsy due to other causes (ENVM) in women with epilepsy
outcome: rate of delivery by cesarean section
cohort: The cohort consisted of 45 women with epilepsy due to cerebral vascular malformations (EVM) and 96 women with focal epilepsy due to other causes (ENVM), identified from the Kerala Registry of Epilepsy and Pregnancy between 1998 and 2018.
finding: Maternal and fetal outcomes, including seizure relapse and fetal loss/malformations, were comparable between women with EVM and ENVM, although the EVM group had a higher rate of cesarean section and 15% of AVM cases experienced bleeding during pregnancy.
mod_finding: The rate of delivery by cesarean section, adjusted for maternal age, was significantly higher for the EVM group (61.2%) compared to the ENVM group (39%).
